summary: The PR addresses the issue of using the provided tzinfo parameter in TruncDate and TruncTime functions, but there are some concerns regarding test coverage and documentation.

issues.description: The PR does not include additional tests to verify the new functionality with different time zones, which could help ensure that the fix works as expected in various scenarios.
The PR does not update the docstrings or comments to reflect the changes made, which could confuse future developers about the purpose and usage of the tzinfo parameter.
